Definition of chromatic adjective from the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary

chromatic

adjective
 
/krəˈmætɪk/
 
/krəˈmætɪk/
(music)
jump to other results
  1. of the chromatic scale, a series of musical notes that rise and fall in semitones compare diatonic
    Word Originearly 17th cent.: from French chromatique or Latin chromaticus, from Greek khrōmatikos, from khrōma, khrōmat- ‘colour, chromatic scale’.

See chromatic in the Oxford Advanced American Dictionary
